approved_task_config.title: Contraction of interleaved projection scans from one contracting ordering
standard_prerequisites: Hilbert spaces, bounded operators and orthogonal projections
Pythagorean identity, triangle and Cauchy-Schwarz inequalities
Operator norm and elementary scalar inequalities
delta is the nonnegative spectral-gap parameter referred to in the author paragraph at source line722, not an arbitrary real number.
core_obligations: Peel off the prescribed ordering despite inserted projections
Charge deviation to disjoint intervals of extra-projection norm loss
Balance direct energy loss against closeness to the contracting scan
proof_roadmap: Define monotone lambda_l from the product norms.
Write the final product as the known contracting order plus an error.
Recursively peel off first occurrences and use disjoint gap intervals.
Combine lambda>=kappa and the resulting direct contraction bound, then split cases and take a square root.
approved_task_config.difficulty_reason: 给定一个有谱隙的固定投影顺序，要控制含额外投影的交错超序列，不能直接把收缩算子逐项插入后比较范数。证明按首次出现位置反向剥离固定顺序，把额外投影导致的误差归入互不相交的损失区间，并比较“已有能量损失大”和“距离固定收缩扫描近”两种情形，得到随额外步数L-n增长的定量下界。所需反向剥离、区间不重叠及两界平衡完整保留，非一般收缩的例行乘法。
